files.description: CS2-specific game event protobuf messages.  These are temporary entity (TE) events and game events broadcast from the server to clients that are within the relevant PVS or listening for the event type.  Identified by the ECsgoGameEvents enum (450–453).

messages.description: Temporary entity event that triggers a networked animation event on a player's animation graph (jumps, land, crouch transitions, etc.).

fields.description: Entity handle (packed as fixed32) of the player triggering the animation event.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: player

fields.description: Animation event ID matching an entry in the player's animation graph.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: event

fields.description: Optional integer payload passed to the animation event handler.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: data

messages.name: CMsgTEPlayerAnimEvent

messages.description: Triggers the radio-icon animation above a player's head when they use a radio command, showing team-mates which player is communicating.

fields.description: Entity handle (packed as fixed32) of the player using the radio command.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: player

messages.name: CMsgTERadioIcon

messages.description: Temporary entity event broadcast when a player fires a weapon. Received by all clients within PVS range of the shooter's origin.

fields.description: World-space muzzle position from which the bullet was fired.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: origin

fields.description: Aim angles (pitch, yaw) at the moment of fire.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: angles

fields.description: Item definition index (item_definition_index_t) of the weapon fired. Maps to entries in items_game.txt.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: weapon_id

fields.description: Fire mode – 0 for primary, 1 for secondary/burst.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: mode

fields.description: PRNG seed used to reproduce the bullet spread trajectory.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: seed

fields.description: Entity handle of the player who fired (packed as fixed32).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: player

fields.description: Inaccuracy value at time of fire, affecting spread cone.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: inaccuracy

fields.description: Recoil accumulator index used for kick-back calculations.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: recoil_index

fields.description: Weapon spread value at time of fire.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: spread

fields.description: Sound type index controlling which fire-sound variant plays.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: sound_type

fields.description: Item definition index of the firing weapon (same as weapon_id for most weapons).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: item_def_index

fields.description: DSP (digital signal processing) effect hash applied to the fire sound.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: sound_dsp_effect

fields.description: World-space origin of the firing entity (may differ from muzzle origin for some weapon types).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: ent_origin

fields.description: Clip ammo remaining after this shot.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: num_bullets_remaining

fields.description: Attack type identifier (0 = primary, other values for special modes).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: attack_type

fields.description: Optional nested Extra message with additional precision data for demo analysis.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: extra

fields.description: True when the player was airborne at the moment of firing.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: player_inair

fields.description: True when the player was zoomed/scoped at the moment of firing.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: player_scoped

fields.description: Server tick on which the shot was fired.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: tick

messages.name: CMsgTEFireBullets
messages.notes: The seed field allows clients to reproduce the exact bullet spread using the same PRNG as the server, enabling accurate hit-registration replay in demo parsers.

messages.description: Sent to the attacker (and optionally team) when a bullet registers a hit. Used by the client to display hit-marker feedback and play hit sounds.

fields.description: Player slot index of the shooter.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: attacker_slot

fields.description: Player slot index of the entity that was hit.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: victim_slot

fields.description: World-space position of the victim at the moment of impact.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: victim_pos

fields.description: Hit-group constant (head=1, chest=2, stomach=3, leftarm=4, rightarm=5, leftleg=6, rightleg=7).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: hit_group

fields.description: Raw damage dealt before armour reduction.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: damage

fields.description: Number of surfaces the bullet penetrated before this hit.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: penetration_count

fields.description: True if this hit resulted in the victim's death.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: is_kill

messages.name: CMsgPlayerBulletHit

files.name: cs_gameevents.proto

files.description: CS2 user-messages sent reliably from server to one or more clients.  These messages carry HUD feedback, audio triggers, economy updates, and kill-cam data.  They are identified by the ECstrike15UserMessages enum (IDs 301–388).

messages.description: Opens or closes a VGUI panel on the client.  Used to trigger buy menus, team-selection screens, and other UI panels.

fields.description: Panel name string identifying which VGUI menu to show/hide.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: name

fields.description: True to open the panel, false to close it.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: show

fields.description: Optional key-value pairs passed to the panel's initialization code.
fields.label: repeated
fields.name: keys

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_VGUIMenu

messages.description: Legacy Geiger-counter sound message inherited from Half-Life; not used in CS2 gameplay but retained for protocol compatibility.

fields.description: Distance value that determined Geiger sound frequency in HL1.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: range

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_Geiger

messages.description: Controls the on-screen train speed/direction indicator (legacy HL1 message).

fields.description: Train-control state integer.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: train

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_Train

messages.description: Displays a plain text string in the centre of the HUD for a brief period.

fields.description: UTF-8 string to display on the HUD.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: text

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_HudText

messages.description: Displays a richly formatted HUD message with custom position, colour, fade-in/out timing, and special effects.

fields.description: HUD channel index (0–3); newer messages on the same channel replace older ones.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: channel

fields.description: Normalised (0–1) screen-space position of the message.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: pos

fields.description: Primary text colour (RGBA).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: clr1

fields.description: Secondary/effect colour (RGBA).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: clr2

fields.description: Text effect type (0 = none, 1 = flicker, 2 = fade-in).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: effect

fields.description: Time in seconds for the message to fade in.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: fade_in_time

fields.description: Time in seconds for the message to fade out.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: fade_out_time

fields.description: Time in seconds to hold the message at full opacity.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: hold_time

fields.description: Duration in seconds of the special text effect.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: fx_time

fields.description: UTF-8 message string to display.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: text

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_HudMsg

messages.description: Applies a camera-shake effect on the receiving client.  Used for nearby explosions, heavy landing impacts, and environmental effects.

fields.description: Shake command: 0 = start, 1 = stop, 2 = amplitude (additive).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: command

fields.description: Peak displacement of the shake in world units.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: local_amplitude

fields.description: Oscillation frequency of the shake in Hz.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: frequency

fields.description: Duration of the shake in seconds.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: duration

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_Shake

messages.description: Fades the client's screen to or from a solid colour.  Used for flash-bang recovery, level transitions, and damage feedback.

fields.description: Duration of the fade in 1/100ths of a second.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: duration

fields.description: Time in 1/100ths of a second to hold the peak colour before fading back.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: hold_time

fields.description: Flags: 0x0001 = fade-in (screen → colour), 0x0002 = fade-out (colour → screen), 0x0004 = modulate (multiplicative), 0x0008 = stayout.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: flags

fields.description: Target RGBA colour of the full-screen overlay.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: clr

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_Fade

messages.description: Triggers a gamepad rumble pattern on the receiving client.

fields.description: Rumble-effect preset index.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: index

fields.description: Additional data parameter for the rumble effect.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: data

fields.description: Rumble control flags.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: flags

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_Rumble

messages.description: Displays a closed-caption subtitle string on the client by localization token hash.

fields.description: CRC32 hash of the localization token for the caption string.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: hash

fields.description: Display duration in 1/10ths of a second.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: duration

fields.description: True when the caption originates from player speech (enables speaker indicator).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: from_player

fields.description: Plaintext localization token (fallback when hash lookup fails).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: cctoken

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_CloseCaption

messages.description: Plays a named radio-command audio file on the client (radio-wheel voice lines).

fields.description: Sound event name or path of the radio voice-line to play.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: radio_sound

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_SendAudio

messages.description: Streams raw voice audio from a player to a spectator or teammate.

fields.description: Playback pitch shift applied to the voice audio.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: pitch

fields.description: Entity index of the player speaking.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: entidx

fields.description: Duration of the audio clip in seconds.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: duration

fields.description: Path to the voice audio file.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: voice_filename

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_RawAudio

messages.description: Pushes the server's voice-mute state to clients so they know which players are muted globally.

fields.description: Per-player mute bitmasks; one entry per possible player slot.
fields.label: repeated
fields.name: player_masks

fields.description: True when the player-controlled muting overrides are active.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: player_mod_enable

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_VoiceMask

messages.description: Notifies the receiving client about incoming damage so the directional damage indicator can be displayed.

fields.description: Amount of damage dealt (used to scale the indicator intensity).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: amount

fields.description: World-space position of the damage source (used to compute indicator direction).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: inflictor_world_pos

fields.description: Entity index of the player who received the damage.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: victim_entindex

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_Damage

messages.description: Displays a radio-command message in the text chat area.

fields.description: Destination filter: 0 = team only, 1 = global.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: msg_dst

fields.description: Player slot index of the radio sender.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: client

fields.description: Radio-command name/localization token.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: msg_name

fields.description: Substitution parameters inserted into the radio command string.
fields.label: repeated
fields.name: params

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_RadioText

messages.description: Displays a game-hint text in the hint area of the HUD (below the centre of the screen).

fields.description: Localization token or plain string for the hint.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: message

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_HintText

messages.description: Displays multiple key-binding hint strings in the hint area (used for context-sensitive prompts like 'Press [USE] to pick up hostage').

fields.description: List of localization tokens for each key-hint line.
fields.label: repeated
fields.name: messages

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_KeyHintText

messages.description: Pushes an incremental update to the client's radar entity-spotted list, keeping the minimap positions of spotted enemies and the bomb in sync.

fields.description: True when this is a fresh full update rather than a delta update.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: new_update

fields.description: List of spotted-entity records, each containing position, class, and equipment status.
fields.label: repeated
fields.name: entity_updates

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_ProcessSpottedEntityUpdate

messages.description: Triggers a weapon-reload visual effect at the specified world position (shell casing eject, etc.) on remote clients.

fields.description: Entity index of the weapon being reloaded.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: entidx

fields.description: Activity/animation index that triggered the reload effect.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: actanim

fields.description: X world-space coordinate of the effect origin.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: origin_x

fields.description: Y world-space coordinate of the effect origin.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: origin_y

fields.description: Z world-space coordinate of the effect origin.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: origin_z

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_ReloadEffect

messages.description: Plays a weapon sound at a specific world position; used for sounds that must be heard at a precise location (fire, reload, bolt action).

fields.description: Entity index of the weapon producing the sound.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: entidx

fields.description: X world-space coordinate of the sound origin.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: origin_x

fields.description: Y world-space coordinate of the sound origin.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: origin_y

fields.description: Z world-space coordinate of the sound origin.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: origin_z

fields.description: Sound event name to play.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: sound

fields.description: Server game-time at which the sound originated (used for latency-compensated audio sync).
fields.label: optional

fields.description: Hash of the soundscape that was active when the sound was emitted.
fields.label: optional

messages.name: CCSUsrMsg_WeaponSound

messages.description: Animates the target's health-bar indicator (the hitmarker health-bar and the bomb defuse progress ring) on the HUD.

fields.label: optional

messages.description: Enables or disables the outline-highlight (X-ray glow) on a specific entity for the receiving client (used by spectator tools and some convars).

files.name: cstrike15_usermessages.proto

files.description: Source 2 base game-event protobuf messages.  Provides the Source 1-legacy game-event bridge (CMsgSource1LegacyGameEvent), sound-system events (SoS), and surface-decal events.  Identified by the EBaseGameEvents enum (200–212).

messages.description: Debug event that reports the current game-session ID string to a specific client.  Used during development to trace session continuity.

fields.description: Slot index of the client receiving the session-ID debug information.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: clientid

fields.description: Unique string identifier for the current game session.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: gamesessionid

messages.name: CMsgVDebugGameSessionIDEvent

messages.description: Instructs clients to paint a decal (bullet hole, blood splatter, spray) onto a surface or entity in the world.

fields.description: World-space hit position where the decal should be placed.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: position

fields.description: Surface normal at the hit position; orients the decal correctly.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: normal

fields.description: Secondary axis vector for texture alignment.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: saxis

fields.description: Bone index when the decal is attached to an animated model (-1 for world surfaces).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: boneindex

fields.description: Decal flags bitmask (temporary, permanent, etc.).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: flags

fields.description: RGBA colour tint applied to the decal texture.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: color

fields.description: Random seed used to select from a decal group variant.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: random_seed

fields.description: Hash of the decal group name (e.g. 'BulletImpactConcrete').
fields.label: optional
fields.name: decal_group_name

fields.description: Override size in world units (0 = use default decal size).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: size_override

fields.description: Entity handle to attach the decal to (0xFFFFFF = world).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: entityhandle

fields.description: Material ID of the surface at the hit point.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: material_id

fields.description: Hash of the decal sequence name for animated decals.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: sequence_name

fields.description: Mesh triangle index for precise placement on complex geometry.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: triangleindex

messages.name: CMsgPlaceDecalEvent

messages.name: CMsgClearDecalsForEntityEvent

messages.description: Sent once at the start of a connection to register all Source 1 game-event schemas with the client.  The client uses this list to decode subsequent CMsgSource1LegacyGameEvent messages by ID.
messages.name: CMsgSource1LegacyGameEventList
messages.notes: This is the Source 2 equivalent of the Source 1 'svc_GameEventList' message. All classic CS:GO game events (player_death, bomb_planted, etc.) are transmitted through this bridge.

messages.description: Registers which Source 1 game-events a specific client wishes to receive. Used by plugins and spectators to opt in to event streams.

fields.description: Player slot that is registering these event listeners.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: playerslot

fields.description: Packed bitmask array; bit N set means listen for game-event with ID N.
fields.label: repeated
fields.name: eventarraybits

messages.name: CMsgSource1LegacyListenEvents

messages.description: Carries a single Source 1 game-event (player_death, weapon_fire, bomb_planted, etc.) over the Source 2 network layer.  The event-type name and all key–value pairs are encoded inside the keys list.

fields.description: String name of the game event (e.g. 'player_death', 'bomb_planted').
fields.label: optional
fields.name: event_name

fields.description: Numeric event ID assigned during registration via CMsgSource1LegacyGameEventList.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: eventid

fields.description: Typed key–value pairs carrying event-specific data (integers, floats, strings, booleans).
fields.label: repeated
fields.name: keys

fields.description: Server tick on which the event was fired.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: server_tick

fields.description: Passthrough flag used internally by the event system.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: passthrough

messages.name: CMsgSource1LegacyGameEvent
messages.notes: CS2 game events (player_death, round_start, bomb_exploded, etc.) are all transmitted as CMsgSource1LegacyGameEvent messages.  Use the event_name field to identify them and CMsgSource1LegacyGameEventList to decode keys.

messages.description: Starts a named sound event through the SoS (Sound Operating System) layer, associated with an optional source entity.

fields.label: optional
fields.name: soundevent_guid

fields.description: CRC32 hash of the sound event name string.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: soundevent_hash

fields.description: Entity index of the sound source (-1 = world/positional).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: source_entity_index

fields.description: Random seed for sound variation selection.
fields.label: optional
fields.name: seed

fields.description: Packed binary parameters for the sound event (volume, pitch, position, etc.).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: packed_params

fields.description: Game time at which the sound should start playing (allows latency compensation).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: start_time

messages.name: CMsgSosStartSoundEvent

messages.description: Stops a specific sound instance identified by its GUID.

fields.label: optional
fields.name: soundevent_guid

messages.name: CMsgSosStopSoundEvent

messages.description: Stops all sound instances matching the given sound-event hash on the specified source entity.

fields.description: CRC32 hash of the sound event name to stop.
fields.label: optional

fields.description: Entity index to restrict the stop to (-1 = stop all matching sounds).
fields.label: optional
fields.name: source_entity_index

messages.name: CMsgSosStopSoundEventHash

messages.description: Updates runtime parameters of an active sound event without restarting it (e.g. volume fade, pitch shift on a looping ambient sound).

fields.description: GUID of the active sound instance to modify.
